name: Multi-Signal B2B Buying Intent Radar (ATS Hiring + Google Ads + Scoring)

parameters.content:
## Multi-Signal B2B Buying Intent Radar (ATS Hiring + Google Ads)

### How it works
This workflow monitors target B2B accounts from **Google Sheets** every weekday and runs **two HTTP-only Apify Actors in parallel** (zero proxies, zero headless browsers):
1. [Direct Career Site Jobs Search](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/career-site-jobs-search) — scans Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and SmartRecruiters boards (25,787 employers) for new roles, salaries, seniority, and 65+ tech skills.
2. [Google Ads Transparency Scraper](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/google-ads-transparency-scraper) — detects new Google Search, Display, and YouTube ads plus campaign longevity (`activeDays`).

Both use incremental cursors (`onlyNewSinceLastRun: true`) so scheduled runs never bill twice for seen items, while sentinel fallback guarantees the merge never stalls on quiet days or single-source errors. Signals are unified across account aliases, scored **0–100**, and routed:
- **HOT (>= 50)**: Deduplicated Sheet upsert (`signalKey`) + Slack alert to `#sales-signals` in parallel.
- **WARM (20–49)**: Logged to Google Sheets for weekly review.
- **QUIET (< 20)**: Filtered out.

### Setup
1. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential: Name = `Authorization`, Value = `Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>`.
2. Create a Google Sheet with tabs `Target_Accounts` (`accountName`, `domain`, `atsTarget`, `owner`, `active`) and `Buying_Signals`, then replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`.
3. Connect **Slack** (`#sales-signals`, `#ops-alerts`) and activate the schedule.

### Customization
- Tune role keywords or scoring weights in **Filter & Build Batch Payloads** and **Aggregate & Score Buying Intent per Account**.
- Set `includeDetails: true` in **Fetch New Competitor Google Ads** for EU DSA impression ranges.

## 1. Load & Sanitize Target Accounts
Reads active target accounts from Google Sheets, deduplicates domains and ATS slugs, and gates each signal branch so empty lists never trigger HTTP 400 errors.

## 2. Parallel Signal Collection
Fetches new ATS career-site openings and new Google Ads simultaneously with `maxTotalChargeUsd=0.25` caps, safe empty-day sentinels, and partial-failure routing to `#ops-alerts`.

## 3. Merge, Intent Scoring & Tiered Routing
Combines hiring + ad signals per canonical account, computes a transparent 0–100 buying intent score with outreach angles, and routes **HOT** accounts to Slack + Sheet in parallel and **WARM** accounts to Sheet only.
